verses.verse:
मुखरन्ध्रमितं वशम् षड्भागे परिकल्पयेत्।
अधस्तात् प्रथमों भागस्तस्मिन् भागद्वयं मतम्।49।
verses.text: Divide the bamboo, measured up to the mouth-hole, into six parts; the first part from below is held to have two parts.

commentary.text: Divide the length from P̣a to the mukharandhra (mouth-hole) into six equal parts, and divide the first part from the bottom into two parts.
